Nora Lin: Adding a short FAQ entry for Optimize about kv-prefetch + batch sizing when using low-bit quant profiles (qs4/qs8). Found a miss spike in our staging perf test.

Rahul Singh: Can you paste the minimal repro you'll include? Keep it tiny so users can run it locally.

Nora Lin: Sure — python example I'll add:

```python
from redwood import OptimizeClient
c = OptimizeClient()
inputs=[{"input":f"q {i}"} for i in range(32)]
resp = c.generate_batch(model='open-qs8-v2', inputs=inputs, batch_size=16, use_kv_prefetch=True, kv_prefetch_batch_size=4, cache_ttl_seconds=120, quant_profile='qs8')
print(resp.metrics.cache_hits, resp.metrics.cache_misses)
```

Marta Lopez: Recommend a tiny JS snippet too and a one-line rule: "Set kv_prefetch_batch_size <= min(4, batch_size) when using aggressive quant profiles." 

Nora Lin: Will add JS snippet and a dashboard query: `sum(cache_hits)/sum(cache_hits+cache_misses)` over 5m plus alert suggestion (hit_ratio < 0.75 for 10m).

Rahul Singh: Add a CI smoke test in examples/ci that runs the mocked snippet and asserts miss_rate <= 0.2. That should catch regressions.

docs-bot: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1620 "optimize: kv-prefetch quicknote + cross-sdk examples" assigned to @nora.

Nora Lin: Thanks — tagging UX for a screenshot and merging after review :thumbsup:
